import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys,base64
lane=Path.cwd(); res=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text()); ids=set(res['ids'])
def w(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
out=[]

 data=p.read_bytes();ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
